items.title: Elastic looks to speed up Jina Model Inference by 8x using NVIDIA RTX GPUs
items.summary: Elastic is accelerating Jina model inference with NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 GPUs, delivering up to 8x faster embedding, 4x faster reranking, and 3.7x faster OCR to power search and agentic AI.
items.creator: Gregory Chase,Rachael Wade,Kapil Jadhav
